<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>DnDGen.CharacterGen</id>
    <version>16.0.4</version>
    <authors>Karl M. Speer</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <icon>18531-twenty-sided-dice-vector-thumb.png</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/DnDGen/CharacterGen</projectUrl>
    <description>This generates characters and NPCs for the Dungeons and Dragons 3.5 system. One can generate random characters or set various randomizers.</description>
    <releaseNotes>Dependabot updates</releaseNotes>
    <tags>character npc generator dice dungeons dragons d20 dnd 3.5 gen</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/DnDGen/CharacterGen" commit="966e5e80837e65b5b255959d10df789fa8f82f22" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="DnDGen.Infrastructure" version="7.0.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DnDGen.RollGen" version="16.0.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="DnDGen.TreasureGen" version="12.0.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.CSharp" version="4.7.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Ninject" version="3.3.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
